paragraphs.en: About a billion Edge Functions run on Netlify every day — Sunweb personalizing pages, Loto-Québec routing traffic on a cookie check, and hundreds of thousands of other sites doing everything from personalization to routing to auth. All of it runs on a full JavaScript runtime that scales with our customers’ traffic.
paragraphs.zh: 每天约有十亿个边缘函数（Edge Functions）在 Netlify 上运行——Sunweb 在对页面进行个性化处理，Loto-Québec 在通过 Cookie 检查进行流量路由，还有数十万个其他站点在用它完成从个性化到路由再到身份验证的各类任务。 所有这些都在一个可随客户流量扩展的完整 JavaScript 运行时上运行。

sents.en: About a billion Edge Functions run on Netlify every day — Sunweb personalizing pages, Loto-Québec routing traffic on a cookie check, and hundreds of thousands of other sites doing everything from personalization to routing to auth.
sents.zh: 每天约有十亿个边缘函数（Edge Functions）在 Netlify 上运行——Sunweb 在对页面进行个性化处理，Loto-Québec 在通过 Cookie 检查进行流量路由，还有数十万个其他站点在用它完成从个性化到路由再到身份验证的各类任务。

sents.en: All of it runs on a full JavaScript runtime that scales with our customers’ traffic.
sents.zh: 所有这些都在一个可随客户流量扩展的完整 JavaScript 运行时上运行。

paragraphs.en: This poses a significant technical challenge, as we strive to make the latency as low as possible. To run tens, sometimes hundreds of thousands, of edge functions per second, we need to process each request, route it correctly, allocate compute capacity, and boot both our platform code and the customer’s code. All of that has to happen within milliseconds.
paragraphs.zh: 这带来了一个重大的技术挑战，因为我们要努力将延迟降到尽可能低。 为了每秒运行数万、有时甚至数十万个边缘函数，我们需要处理每个请求、正确地进行路由、分配计算资源，并启动我们的平台代码和客户的代码。 所有这些都必须在几毫秒内完成。

sents.en: This poses a significant technical challenge, as we strive to make the latency as low as possible.
sents.zh: 这带来了一个重大的技术挑战，因为我们要努力将延迟降到尽可能低。

sents.en: To run tens, sometimes hundreds of thousands, of edge functions per second, we need to process each request, route it correctly, allocate compute capacity, and boot both our platform code and the customer’s code.
sents.zh: 为了每秒运行数万、有时甚至数十万个边缘函数，我们需要处理每个请求、正确地进行路由、分配计算资源，并启动我们的平台代码和客户的代码。

sents.en: All of that has to happen within milliseconds.
sents.zh: 所有这些都必须在几毫秒内完成。

paragraphs.en: Over the past several months, our team has rebuilt the infrastructure behind Edge Functions, working closely with the team at Unikraft , who wrote about the experience from their side . In the past, requests went out to a hosted execution service. Today, they run on MicroVMs inside our own edge network — roughly 5x faster at the median. That shift also improves security and reliability, and opens up more possibilities for running complex compute at the edge.
paragraphs.zh: 过去几个月里，我们的团队重建了 Edge Functions 背后的基础设施，并与 Unikraft 团队紧密合作，他们从自己的角度撰写了这次合作的经验。 在过去，请求会发送到一个托管的执行服务。 如今，它们在我们自己的边缘网络内的 MicroVM 上运行——中位数速度大约快了 5 倍。 这一转变还提升了安全性和可靠性，并为在边缘运行复杂计算开辟了更多可能性。

sents.en: Over the past several months, our team has rebuilt the infrastructure behind Edge Functions, working closely with the team at Unikraft , who wrote about the experience from their side .
sents.zh: 过去几个月里，我们的团队重建了 Edge Functions 背后的基础设施，并与 Unikraft 团队紧密合作，他们从自己的角度撰写了这次合作的经验。

sents.en: In the past, requests went out to a hosted execution service.
sents.zh: 在过去，请求会发送到一个托管的执行服务。

sents.en: Today, they run on MicroVMs inside our own edge network — roughly 5x faster at the median.
sents.zh: 如今，它们在我们自己的边缘网络内的 MicroVM 上运行——中位数速度大约快了 5 倍。

sents.en: That shift also improves security and reliability, and opens up more possibilities for running complex compute at the edge.
sents.zh: 这一转变还提升了安全性和可靠性，并为在边缘运行复杂计算开辟了更多可能性。

paragraphs.en: This doesn’t change how Edge Functions are written or used — URL imports, npm packages, Node built-ins, netlify.toml declarations, local development — all of it works exactly as it did before. It’s now faster and more resilient. In this article we’d like to share more about the new architecture and our learnings on building a new compute platform that’s able to serve high volume at a low performance overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 这不会改变 Edge Functions 的编写或使用方式——URL 导入、npm 包、Node 内置模块、netlify.toml 声明、本地开发——所有这些都和以前完全一样。 它现在更快、更具弹性。 在本文中，我们想分享更多关于新架构的内容，以及我们在构建一个能够在低性能开销下服务高流量的新计算平台方面的经验与心得。

sents.en: This doesn’t change how Edge Functions are written or used — URL imports, npm packages, Node built-ins, netlify.toml declarations, local development — all of it works exactly as it did before.
sents.zh: 这不会改变 Edge Functions 的编写或使用方式——URL 导入、npm 包、Node 内置模块、netlify.toml 声明、本地开发——所有这些都和以前完全一样。

sents.en: It’s now faster and more resilient.
sents.zh: 它现在更快、更具弹性。

sents.en: In this article we’d like to share more about the new architecture and our learnings on building a new compute platform that’s able to serve high volume at a low performance overhead.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们想分享更多关于新架构的内容，以及我们在构建一个能够在低性能开销下服务高流量的新计算平台方面的经验与心得。

paragraphs.en: An edge function runs in front of a site, on every request that matches it. The time it takes is time a customer spends waiting, so milliseconds here count for more than they do almost anywhere else.
paragraphs.zh: 边缘函数运行在站点的前端，对每个匹配它的请求执行。 它所耗费的时间就是客户等待的时间，因此这里的毫秒数几乎比其他任何地方都更为重要。

sents.en: An edge function runs in front of a site, on every request that matches it.
sents.zh: 边缘函数运行在站点的前端，对每个匹配它的请求执行。

sents.en: The time it takes is time a customer spends waiting, so milliseconds here count for more than they do almost anywhere else.
sents.zh: 它所耗费的时间就是客户等待的时间，因此这里的毫秒数几乎比其他任何地方都更为重要。

paragraphs.zh: 一次温暖的调用——路由到计算节点、进入 MicroVM、运行函数、生成响应头——现在的开销为：

paragraphs.en: A cold invocation is worth stating too. When a request arrives in a region that no compute node has seen before, it needs to fetch the relevant images before it’s able to run anything. This happens on about 1.2% of invocations and takes about 9ms on average.
paragraphs.zh: 冷调用也值得一提。 当一个请求到达某个之前没有计算节点见过的区域时，它需要先获取相关镜像才能运行任何内容。 这种情况大约发生在 1.2% 的调用中，平均耗时约 9 毫秒。

sents.en: A cold invocation is worth stating too.
sents.zh: 冷调用也值得一提。

sents.en: When a request arrives in a region that no compute node has seen before, it needs to fetch the relevant images before it’s able to run anything.
sents.zh: 当一个请求到达某个之前没有计算节点见过的区域时，它需要先获取相关镜像才能运行任何内容。

sents.en: This happens on about 1.2% of invocations and takes about 9ms on average.
sents.zh: 这种情况大约发生在 1.2% 的调用中，平均耗时约 9 毫秒。

paragraphs.en: What follows is the path a single request takes, in order: it arrives at the edge node, it’s turned into a specification, is routed to a compute node, and then handed off to a MicroVM that may or may not already exist based on whether it’s a cold or warm invocation.
paragraphs.zh: 以下是单个请求所经过的路径，按顺序为：请求到达边缘节点，被转换为规范，路由到计算节点，然后移交给一个 MicroVM——该 MicroVM 可能已存在，也可能尚未存在，取决于这是冷调用还是热调用。

paragraphs.en: Every request lands on the Netlify edge node closest to the client. The node terminates the TLS connection and checks the request path against the Edge Functions’ routes for that deploy.
paragraphs.zh: 每个请求都会落到距离客户端最近的 Netlify 边缘节点。 该节点终止 TLS 连接，并根据该次部署的边缘函数路由检查请求路径。

sents.en: Every request lands on the Netlify edge node closest to the client.
sents.zh: 每个请求都会落到距离客户端最近的 Netlify 边缘节点。

sents.en: The node terminates the TLS connection and checks the request path against the Edge Functions’ routes for that deploy.
sents.zh: 该节点终止 TLS 连接，并根据该次部署的边缘函数路由检查请求路径。

paragraphs.en: If nothing matches, the request carries on to the cache and onto the origin as usual. If a route does match, this is the point where the request used to leave our network. With our old infrastructure it went out over the internet, ran the edge function, and came back to us to pass on. With the new compute platform, the request is forwarded to a compute node within our network.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有任何匹配，请求将照常继续传递到缓存和源站。 如果有路由匹配，这就是过去请求离开我们网络的地方。 在旧的基础设施下，请求会通过互联网发出，运行边缘函数，然后再返回给我们进行传递。 在新的计算平台上，请求会被转发到我们网络内的一个计算节点。

sents.en: If nothing matches, the request carries on to the cache and onto the origin as usual.
sents.zh: 如果没有任何匹配，请求将照常继续传递到缓存和源站。

sents.en: If a route does match, this is the point where the request used to leave our network.
sents.zh: 如果有路由匹配，这就是过去请求离开我们网络的地方。

sents.en: With our old infrastructure it went out over the internet, ran the edge function, and came back to us to pass on.
sents.zh: 在旧的基础设施下，请求会通过互联网发出，运行边缘函数，然后再返回给我们进行传递。

sents.en: With the new compute platform, the request is forwarded to a compute node within our network.
sents.zh: 在新的计算平台上，请求会被转发到我们网络内的一个计算节点。

paragraphs.en: When the compute node receives the request with the machine specification and the service ID, it first checks to see if a service with that ID already exists. If it does, it forwards the request into the service for it to send into the MicroVM. A service lets us have multiple MicroVMs associated with the same site’s Edge Functions, and allows us to configure parameters for when to scale MicroVMs in and out. For example, we configure each service to only allow a fixed number of requests to be handled by a MicroVM before we shut it down, to avoid MicroVMs running indefinitely. We use the same parameters to know when to eagerly boot up another MicroVM in anticipation of one shutting down.
paragraphs.zh: 当计算节点收到包含机器规格和服务 ID 的请求时，它首先检查具有该 ID 的服务是否已经存在。 如果存在，它将请求转发到该服务中，以便将请求发送到 MicroVM。 服务让我们能够将多个 MicroVM 关联到同一站点的 Edge Functions，并允许我们配置何时扩容和缩容 MicroVM 的参数。 例如，我们将每个服务配置为只允许一个 MicroVM 在关闭之前处理固定数量的请求，以避免 MicroVM 无限期地运行。 我们使用相同的参数来决定何时提前启动另一个 MicroVM，以预判某个 MicroVM 即将关闭。

sents.en: When the compute node receives the request with the machine specification and the service ID, it first checks to see if a service with that ID already exists.
sents.zh: 当计算节点收到包含机器规格和服务 ID 的请求时，它首先检查具有该 ID 的服务是否已经存在。

sents.en: If it does, it forwards the request into the service for it to send into the MicroVM.
sents.zh: 如果存在，它将请求转发到该服务中，以便将请求发送到 MicroVM。

sents.en: A service lets us have multiple MicroVMs associated with the same site’s Edge Functions, and allows us to configure parameters for when to scale MicroVMs in and out.
sents.zh: 服务让我们能够将多个 MicroVM 关联到同一站点的 Edge Functions，并允许我们配置何时扩容和缩容 MicroVM 的参数。

sents.en: For example, we configure each service to only allow a fixed number of requests to be handled by a MicroVM before we shut it down, to avoid MicroVMs running indefinitely.
sents.zh: 例如，我们将每个服务配置为只允许一个 MicroVM 在关闭之前处理固定数量的请求，以避免 MicroVM 无限期地运行。

sents.en: We use the same parameters to know when to eagerly boot up another MicroVM in anticipation of one shutting down.
sents.zh: 我们使用相同的参数来决定何时提前启动另一个 MicroVM，以预判某个 MicroVM 即将关闭。

paragraphs.en: If a service for the site’s edge functions doesn’t already exist on the compute node, one is created, and we check to see if we have all the images in the machine specification on disk. If any are missing, they’re fetched from the edge node and written to disk. This approach means we only fetch the edge function images that are receiving traffic in that region.
paragraphs.zh: 如果该站点的边缘函数服务在计算节点上尚不存在，则会创建一个服务，并检查机器规格中的所有镜像是否已存在于磁盘上。 如果有任何镜像缺失，我们会从边缘节点获取它们并写入磁盘。 这种方法意味着我们只获取该区域中正在接收流量的边缘函数镜像。

sents.en: If a service for the site’s edge functions doesn’t already exist on the compute node, one is created, and we check to see if we have all the images in the machine specification on disk.
sents.zh: 如果该站点的边缘函数服务在计算节点上尚不存在，则会创建一个服务，并检查机器规格中的所有镜像是否已存在于磁盘上。

sents.en: If any are missing, they’re fetched from the edge node and written to disk.
sents.zh: 如果有任何镜像缺失，我们会从边缘节点获取它们并写入磁盘。

sents.en: This approach means we only fetch the edge function images that are receiving traffic in that region.
sents.zh: 这种方法意味着我们只获取该区域中正在接收流量的边缘函数镜像。

paragraphs.en: Before the request goes anywhere, the edge node writes a specification for the machine that will run a function. The spec names three images: the runtime, our platform image, and the edge function image. It also sets the CPU, memory, and connection limits.
paragraphs.zh: 在请求被发往任何地方之前，边缘节点会先为将要运行该函数的机器写入一份规格说明。 该规格说明命名了三个镜像：运行时镜像、我们的平台镜像，以及边缘函数镜像。 它还会设置 CPU、内存和连接数上限。

sents.en: Before the request goes anywhere, the edge node writes a specification for the machine that will run a function.
sents.zh: 在请求被发往任何地方之前，边缘节点会先为将要运行该函数的机器写入一份规格说明。

sents.en: The spec names three images: the runtime, our platform image, and the edge function image.
sents.zh: 该规格说明命名了三个镜像：运行时镜像、我们的平台镜像，以及边缘函数镜像。

sents.en: It also sets the CPU, memory, and connection limits.
sents.zh: 它还会设置 CPU、内存和连接数上限。

paragraphs.en: The spec travels with the request, on every request. Its hash and site-specific information is computed to become a service ID. This allows for isolation, since two deploys with different code or different environment variables are different services, and they never share a MicroVM.
paragraphs.zh: 该规范随请求一起传输，在每次请求中都存在。 通过计算其哈希值和站点特定信息来生成服务 ID。 这实现了隔离，因为两次部署若代码不同或环境变量不同，就是不同的服务，它们永远不会共享同一个 MicroVM。

sents.en: The spec travels with the request, on every request.
sents.zh: 该规范随请求一起传输，在每次请求中都存在。

sents.en: Its hash and site-specific information is computed to become a service ID.
sents.zh: 通过计算其哈希值和站点特定信息来生成服务 ID。

sents.en: This allows for isolation, since two deploys with different code or different environment variables are different services, and they never share a MicroVM.
sents.zh: 这实现了隔离，因为两次部署若代码不同或环境变量不同，就是不同的服务，它们永远不会共享同一个 MicroVM。

paragraphs.en: This isolation matters most for failures we don’t want to be possible. A potentially compromised deploy runs in a separate MicroVM, and even if it escapes the runtime, it cannot poison other customers or the compute layer itself. V8 isolates, no matter their name, do not provide this level of isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 这种隔离对于我们最不希望发生的故障来说最为关键。 一个可能已被攻陷的部署运行在独立的 MicroVM 中，即使它逃出了运行时，也无法污染其他客户或计算层本身。 V8 隔离区，无论其名称如何，都无法提供这种级别的隔离。

sents.en: This isolation matters most for failures we don’t want to be possible.
sents.zh: 这种隔离对于我们最不希望发生的故障来说最为关键。

sents.en: A potentially compromised deploy runs in a separate MicroVM, and even if it escapes the runtime, it cannot poison other customers or the compute layer itself.
sents.zh: 一个可能已被攻陷的部署运行在独立的 MicroVM 中，即使它逃出了运行时，也无法污染其他客户或计算层本身。

sents.en: V8 isolates, no matter their name, do not provide this level of isolation.
sents.zh: V8 隔离区，无论其名称如何，都无法提供这种级别的隔离。

paragraphs.en: Each region has a group of compute nodes. The edge node picks one for the service using rendezvous hashing: the same service lands on the same node every time, which is what keeps a MicroVM warm and the code already on disk and in cache once it’s been read. This stickiness gives us a caching strategy. If we spread requests evenly across the swarm, we’d end up with a higher level of cold starts.
paragraphs.zh: 每个区域都有一组计算节点。 边缘节点使用会合哈希（rendezvous hashing）为该服务挑选一个节点：同一个服务每次都会落在同一个节点上，这正是让 MicroVM 保持温热、并且代码一旦被读取就保留在磁盘和缓存中的关键。 这种粘性为我们提供了一种缓存策略。 如果我们把请求均匀地分散到整个集群中，最终会导致更多的冷启动。

sents.en: Each region has a group of compute nodes.
sents.zh: 每个区域都有一组计算节点。

sents.en: The edge node picks one for the service using rendezvous hashing: the same service lands on the same node every time, which is what keeps a MicroVM warm and the code already on disk and in cache once it’s been read.
sents.zh: 边缘节点使用会合哈希（rendezvous hashing）为该服务挑选一个节点：同一个服务每次都会落在同一个节点上，这正是让 MicroVM 保持温热、并且代码一旦被读取就保留在磁盘和缓存中的关键。

sents.en: This stickiness gives us a caching strategy.
sents.zh: 这种粘性为我们提供了一种缓存策略。

sents.en: If we spread requests evenly across the swarm, we’d end up with a higher level of cold starts.
sents.zh: 如果我们把请求均匀地分散到整个集群中，最终会导致更多的冷启动。

paragraphs.en: It’s important to remember that while sending every request for a function to the same compute node is the fast path, it’s also how a hot spot forms — where one busy function competes for resources with everything else on that box. A service taking a large share of a region’s traffic pinned to a single node will saturate the node at the expense of other services.
paragraphs.zh: 需要记住的是，虽然把某个函数的每个请求都发送到同一个计算节点是一条快速通道，但这也会形成热点——一个繁忙的函数会与该节点上的其他所有任务争夺资源。 一个占用某个区域大量流量、并被固定在单一节点上的服务，会把该节点饱和耗尽，从而损害其他服务。

sents.en: It’s important to remember that while sending every request for a function to the same compute node is the fast path, it’s also how a hot spot forms — where one busy function competes for resources with everything else on that box.
sents.zh: 需要记住的是，虽然把某个函数的每个请求都发送到同一个计算节点是一条快速通道，但这也会形成热点——一个繁忙的函数会与该节点上的其他所有任务争夺资源。

sents.en: A service taking a large share of a region’s traffic pinned to a single node will saturate the node at the expense of other services.
sents.zh: 一个占用某个区域大量流量、并被固定在单一节点上的服务，会把该节点饱和耗尽，从而损害其他服务。

paragraphs.en: We balance this by relaxing the stickiness. Over a certain threshold, we spread the service across a slice of nodes. This lets us absorb sudden spikes in traffic from a single customer without affecting other services that hashed to the same node.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过放宽粘性来平衡这一点。 超过某个阈值后，我们会把该服务分散到一组节点上。 这让我们能够吸收来自单一客户的突发流量高峰，同时不影响哈希到同一节点的其他服务。

sents.en: We balance this by relaxing the stickiness.
sents.zh: 我们通过放宽粘性来平衡这一点。

sents.en: Over a certain threshold, we spread the service across a slice of nodes.
sents.zh: 超过某个阈值后，我们会把该服务分散到一组节点上。

sents.en: This lets us absorb sudden spikes in traffic from a single customer without affecting other services that hashed to the same node.
sents.zh: 这让我们能够吸收来自单一客户的突发流量高峰，同时不影响哈希到同一节点的其他服务。

paragraphs.en: Finally, once a node is chosen, it pulls in the function’s code. A compute node that has served the function before already has it. A node seeing it for the first time fetches it once and caches it, so only the first request pays that cost.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，一旦选定了某个节点，该节点就会拉取该函数的代码。 之前已经服务过该函数的计算节点上已经有这份代码。 首次遇到该函数的智能体节点会获取一次代码并缓存起来，因此只有第一次请求需要付出这个成本。

sents.en: Finally, once a node is chosen, it pulls in the function’s code.
sents.zh: 最后，一旦选定了某个节点，该节点就会拉取该函数的代码。

sents.en: A compute node that has served the function before already has it.
sents.zh: 之前已经服务过该函数的计算节点上已经有这份代码。

sents.en: A node seeing it for the first time fetches it once and caches it, so only the first request pays that cost.
sents.zh: 首次遇到该函数的智能体节点会获取一次代码并缓存起来，因此只有第一次请求需要付出这个成本。

paragraphs.en: Each function runs in its own Firecracker MicroVM. These are created in under a millisecond and start in about 2ms at p99, because the VM starts a stripped-down Linux environment rather than a full operating system. The edge function’s files are mounted as an uncompressed EROFS image and then memory-mapped, so the VM reads only the parts of the bundle it actually uses instead of loading all of it.
paragraphs.zh: 每个函数都运行在自己的 Firecracker MicroVM 中。 这些 MicroVM 的创建时间不到一毫秒，p99 启动时间约为 2 毫秒，因为虚拟机启动的是一个精简的 Linux 环境，而不是完整的操作系统。 边缘函数的文件以未压缩的 EROFS 镜像形式挂载，然后进行内存映射，因此虚拟机只读取代码包中它实际使用的部分，而不是加载全部内容。

sents.en: Each function runs in its own Firecracker MicroVM.
sents.zh: 每个函数都运行在自己的 Firecracker MicroVM 中。

sents.en: These are created in under a millisecond and start in about 2ms at p99, because the VM starts a stripped-down Linux environment rather than a full operating system.
sents.zh: 这些 MicroVM 的创建时间不到一毫秒，p99 启动时间约为 2 毫秒，因为虚拟机启动的是一个精简的 Linux 环境，而不是完整的操作系统。

sents.en: The edge function’s files are mounted as an uncompressed EROFS image and then memory-mapped, so the VM reads only the parts of the bundle it actually uses instead of loading all of it.
sents.zh: 边缘函数的文件以未压缩的 EROFS 镜像形式挂载，然后进行内存映射，因此虚拟机只读取代码包中它实际使用的部分，而不是加载全部内容。

paragraphs.en: When the MicroVM boots up and the JavaScript server begins to listen on a port, we take a snapshot of the MicroVM. When the edge function isn’t being invoked, the MicroVMs running it scale to zero instead of sitting idle. The next time it’s invoked, we start a new MicroVM from that snapshot. The snapshot is memory-mapped, so the VM can start executing without waiting for the entire snapshot to be read back into memory.
paragraphs.zh: 当 MicroVM 启动且 JavaScript 服务器开始监听某个端口时，我们对 MicroVM 进行快照。 当边缘函数未被调用时，运行它的 MicroVM 会缩容至零，而不是空转待机。 下次该函数被调用时，我们从该快照启动一个新的 MicroVM。 快照采用内存映射方式，因此虚拟机无需等待整个快照重新读入内存即可开始执行。

sents.en: When the MicroVM boots up and the JavaScript server begins to listen on a port, we take a snapshot of the MicroVM.
sents.zh: 当 MicroVM 启动且 JavaScript 服务器开始监听某个端口时，我们对 MicroVM 进行快照。

sents.en: When the edge function isn’t being invoked, the MicroVMs running it scale to zero instead of sitting idle.
sents.zh: 当边缘函数未被调用时，运行它的 MicroVM 会缩容至零，而不是空转待机。

sents.en: The next time it’s invoked, we start a new MicroVM from that snapshot.
sents.zh: 下次该函数被调用时，我们从该快照启动一个新的 MicroVM。

sents.en: The snapshot is memory-mapped, so the VM can start executing without waiting for the entire snapshot to be read back into memory.
sents.zh: 快照采用内存映射方式，因此虚拟机无需等待整个快照重新读入内存即可开始执行。

paragraphs.en: The lifecycle of the VM — boot, snapshot, restore, and scale to zero — is the work of Unikraft’s product. We worked closely with them throughout the migration to make sure it holds up under our request volume and traffic patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 虚拟机的生命周期——启动、快照、恢复以及缩容到零——正是 Unikraft 产品所负责的工作。 在整个迁移过程中，我们与他们紧密合作，以确保它能够承受我们的请求量和流量模式。

sents.en: The lifecycle of the VM — boot, snapshot, restore, and scale to zero — is the work of Unikraft’s product.
sents.zh: 虚拟机的生命周期——启动、快照、恢复以及缩容到零——正是 Unikraft 产品所负责的工作。

sents.en: We worked closely with them throughout the migration to make sure it holds up under our request volume and traffic patterns.
sents.zh: 在整个迁移过程中，我们与他们紧密合作，以确保它能够承受我们的请求量和流量模式。

paragraphs.en: After operating this project for several years, we already had learnings we incorporated to maximize performance and the ability to debug. At scale, we’ve run into all kinds of issues, from running out of ports on virtual switches to DNS (we were surprised, but it wasn’t always DNS).
paragraphs.zh: 在运营这个项目数年之后，我们积累了许多经验并将其融入其中，以最大化性能并提升调试能力。 在大规模场景下，我们遇到过各种各样的问题，从虚拟交换机端口耗尽到 DNS（我们很惊讶，但问题并不总是出在 DNS 上）。

sents.en: After operating this project for several years, we already had learnings we incorporated to maximize performance and the ability to debug.
sents.zh: 在运营这个项目数年之后，我们积累了许多经验并将其融入其中，以最大化性能并提升调试能力。

sents.en: At scale, we’ve run into all kinds of issues, from running out of ports on virtual switches to DNS (we were surprised, but it wasn’t always DNS).
sents.zh: 在大规模场景下，我们遇到过各种各样的问题，从虚拟交换机端口耗尽到 DNS（我们很惊讶，但问题并不总是出在 DNS 上）。

paragraphs.en: In this iteration, we made sure compute nodes run local DNS resolvers. We’ve also expanded the metrics we collect, recording things like boot time, time to first port open, and time to start user code. There are also several circuit breakers in place to ensure prompt rerouting and decommissioning of compute nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 在本次迭代中，我们确保计算节点运行本地 DNS 解析器。 我们还扩展了所收集的指标，记录诸如启动时间、首次开放端口时间和启动用户代码时间等信息。 还部署了多个熔断器，以确保及时重新路由和下线计算节点。

sents.en: In this iteration, we made sure compute nodes run local DNS resolvers.
sents.zh: 在本次迭代中，我们确保计算节点运行本地 DNS 解析器。

sents.en: We’ve also expanded the metrics we collect, recording things like boot time, time to first port open, and time to start user code.
sents.zh: 我们还扩展了所收集的指标，记录诸如启动时间、首次开放端口时间和启动用户代码时间等信息。

sents.en: There are also several circuit breakers in place to ensure prompt rerouting and decommissioning of compute nodes.
sents.zh: 还部署了多个熔断器，以确保及时重新路由和下线计算节点。

paragraphs.en: That’s the whole path, and on a warm instance it adds about 6ms. None of it leaves our network, and we’re in control of the whole request cycle. Everything above happens between the request arriving and the response going back out.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是完整的路径，在一个暖实例上大约会增加 6 毫秒。 这些都不会离开我们的网络，而且我们掌控着整个请求周期。 上面所有这些，都发生在请求到达与响应发出之间。

sents.zh: 这就是完整的路径，在一个暖实例上大约会增加 6 毫秒。

sents.en: None of it leaves our network, and we’re in control of the whole request cycle.

paragraphs.en: When you build a system like the one described above, you’re optimizing for two things at once: the end-user experience and rollout resiliency. We need to be able to roll out changes quickly but balance that with the ability to roll back just as quickly.
paragraphs.zh: 当你构建一个类似上文所描述的系统时，你实际上是在同时优化两件事：终端用户体验和发布韧性。 我们需要能够快速发布变更，同时也要保持能够同样快速地回滚的能力。

sents.en: When you build a system like the one described above, you’re optimizing for two things at once: the end-user experience and rollout resiliency.
sents.zh: 当你构建一个类似上文所描述的系统时，你实际上是在同时优化两件事：终端用户体验和发布韧性。

sents.en: We need to be able to roll out changes quickly but balance that with the ability to roll back just as quickly.
sents.zh: 我们需要能够快速发布变更，同时也要保持能够同样快速地回滚的能力。

paragraphs.en: The compute nodes are built from a base image published by Unikraft and install a set of packages. These nodes are built separately from our edge nodes for a couple of reasons: it keeps our edge nodes lightweight and fast, it lets us use different instance types for our compute nodes, and it lets us scale these nodes independently.
paragraphs.zh: 计算节点基于 Unikraft 发布的基础镜像构建，并安装一组软件包。 这些节点与边缘节点分开构建有以下几个原因：这可以保持边缘节点轻量且快速，允许我们为计算节点使用不同的实例类型，并且可以独立地扩展这些节点。

sents.en: The compute nodes are built from a base image published by Unikraft and install a set of packages.
sents.zh: 计算节点基于 Unikraft 发布的基础镜像构建，并安装一组软件包。

sents.en: These nodes are built separately from our edge nodes for a couple of reasons: it keeps our edge nodes lightweight and fast, it lets us use different instance types for our compute nodes, and it lets us scale these nodes independently.
sents.zh: 这些节点与边缘节点分开构建有以下几个原因：这可以保持边缘节点轻量且快速，允许我们为计算节点使用不同的实例类型，并且可以独立地扩展这些节点。

paragraphs.en: A control plane keeps track of which compute nodes exist and which are healthy, and the edge nodes poll it for that list. It’s also what drives a deploy — a new fleet comes up alongside the running one, scales to match it, and takes over traffic only once it’s healthy.
paragraphs.zh: 控制平面负责跟踪哪些计算节点存在以及哪些是健康的，边缘节点会轮询它以获取该列表。 它也是驱动部署的机制——一个新集群会在正在运行的集群旁启动，扩展到与之匹配的规模，并且只在其达到健康状态后才接管流量。

sents.en: A control plane keeps track of which compute nodes exist and which are healthy, and the edge nodes poll it for that list.
sents.zh: 控制平面负责跟踪哪些计算节点存在以及哪些是健康的，边缘节点会轮询它以获取该列表。

sents.en: It’s also what drives a deploy — a new fleet comes up alongside the running one, scales to match it, and takes over traffic only once it’s healthy.

paragraphs.en: Building the compute infrastructure has required close collaboration with the Unikraft team. Throughout the migration, we’ve worked with them on testing correctness, handling large volumes of requests, and building capabilities specific to our platform.
paragraphs.zh: 构建计算基础设施需要与 Unikraft 团队密切协作。 在整个迁移过程中，我们与他们合作测试正确性、处理大量请求，并构建我们平台专属的能力。

sents.zh: 构建计算基础设施需要与 Unikraft 团队密切协作。

sents.en: Throughout the migration, we’ve worked with them on testing correctness, handling large volumes of requests, and building capabilities specific to our platform.
sents.zh: 在整个迁移过程中，我们与他们合作测试正确性、处理大量请求，并构建我们平台专属的能力。

paragraphs.en: The work to rebuild our edge compute architecture is more than just a speed boost. It’s a faster foundation we can keep building on and have more control over. The best part is that it’s already serving your production traffic today, at the same pricing, with no migration step and nothing to change in any project.
paragraphs.zh: 重建我们的边缘计算架构的工作不仅仅是提升速度。 它是一个更快速的基础，我们可以在此基础上持续构建，并拥有更多控制权。 最棒的是，它如今已在为你的生产流量提供服务，价格不变，无需迁移步骤，任何项目都无需做任何改动。

sents.zh: 它是一个更快速的基础，我们可以在此基础上持续构建，并拥有更多控制权。

sents.en: The best part is that it’s already serving your production traffic today, at the same pricing, with no migration step and nothing to change in any project.
sents.zh: 最棒的是，它如今已在为你的生产流量提供服务，价格不变，无需迁移步骤，任何项目都无需做任何改动。
